cases.prompt: How do I automatically route all Azure resource diagnostic logs to Sentinel using policy?

expect.label: use deployIfNotExists (DINE) policy to auto-configure diagnostic settings
assign built-in diagnostic settings initiative at Landing Zones MG scope
parameterise the workspace resource ID — do not hard-code
run remediation tasks for existing resources after initial assignment
run Deploy-RolesPlan to grant managed identity Monitoring Contributor rights

cases.prompt: How do I reduce Sentinel ingestion cost when collecting diagnostic logs at scale?

expect.label: route high-value security logs to Analytics tier
route high-volume low-fidelity logs to Auxiliary/Basic tier
NSG flow logs use Network Watcher — not diagnostic settings
